ReleaseNotes: SnipEX 2.2.18 keeps itself up to date: when a new version is available at launch it is downloaded, verified, installed, and SnipEX restarts into it automatically (turn this off under Preferences > Update to be asked first). It also adds the Christmas theme with holly-red accents and a snowy backdrop, and gives Hallow's Eve a pumpkin backdrop behind the editor pane. Existing snippets, synchronized libraries, preferences, and sign-in state are preserved. Per-user installation needs no administrator elevation. This employee-testing release remains unsigned.
